for obj in data['objects']:
 print(str(obj)[:1800])

import itertools
objects = {obj['name']:obj for obj in data['objects']}
mesh19, mesh15 = objects['M19'], objects['M15']
tri19 = np.asarray(mesh19['vertices'], dtype=float)[np.asarray(mesh19['triangles'])]
tri15 = np.asarray(mesh15['vertices'], dtype=float)[np.asarray(mesh15['triangles'])]
subsets = [subset for size in (1,2,3) for subset in itertools.combinations(range(3),size)]
def triangle_distance(first, second):
    best = None
    for first_subset in subsets:
        for second_subset in subsets:
            first_base = first[first_subset[0]]
            second_base = second[second_subset[0]]
            columns = [first[index]-first_base for index in first_subset[1:]] + [-(second[index]-second_base) for index in second_subset[1:]]
            params = np.linalg.lstsq(np.array(columns).T,second_base-first_base,rcond=None)[0] if columns else np.array([])
            split = len(first_subset)-1
            first_weights = np.r_[1-params[:split].sum(),params[:split]]
            second_weights = np.r_[1-params[split:].sum(),params[split:]]
            if min(first_weights.min(),second_weights.min()) < -1e-10:
                continue
            first_point = first_weights @ first[list(first_subset)]
            second_point = second_weights @ second[list(second_subset)]
            squared = float(np.dot(second_point-first_point,second_point-first_point))
            if best is None or squared < best[0]-1e-12:
                best = (squared,first_point,second_point)
    return best
results = {}
for label, indices in [('selection',[10,11]),('whole',range(len(tri19)))]:
    best = None
    for first_index in indices:
        for second_index in range(len(tri15)):
            candidate = triangle_distance(tri19[first_index],tri15[second_index])
            if best is None or candidate[0] < best[0]-1e-12:
                best = (*candidate,first_index,second_index)
    results[label] = best
    squared, first_point, second_point, first_index, second_index = best
    distance = np.sqrt(squared)
    print(label,'distance',format(distance,'.12f'),'squared',squared,'direction',(second_point-first_point)/distance)
    print('M19',first_point,'triangle',first_index,'vertices',tri19[first_index].tolist())
    print('M15',second_point,'triangle',second_index,'vertices',tri15[second_index].tolist())

import itertools
verts08=np.asarray(objects['M08']['vertices'],dtype=float)
verts02=np.asarray(objects['M02']['vertices'],dtype=float)
tris08=np.asarray(objects['M08']['triangles'])
tris02=np.asarray(objects['M02']['triangles'])
def closest_triangle_pair(first,second):
 best=None
 for count_a in range(1,4):
  for indices_a in itertools.combinations(range(3),count_a):
   for count_b in range(1,4):
    for indices_b in itertools.combinations(range(3),count_b):
     points_a=first[list(indices_a)]; points_b=second[list(indices_b)]
     basis_a=(points_a[1:]-points_a[0]).T
     basis_b=(points_b[1:]-points_b[0]).T
     basis=np.column_stack((basis_a,-basis_b))
     parameters=np.linalg.lstsq(basis,points_b[0]-points_a[0],rcond=None)[0] if basis.shape[1] else np.empty(0)
     weights_a=np.r_[1-parameters[:count_a-1].sum(),parameters[:count_a-1]]
     weights_b=np.r_[1-parameters[count_a-1:].sum(),parameters[count_a-1:]]
     if min(weights_a.min(),weights_b.min()) < -1e-10: continue
     point_a=weights_a@points_a; point_b=weights_b@points_b
     distance=float(np.linalg.norm(point_b-point_a))
     if best is None or distance < best[0]-1e-12: best=(distance,point_a,point_b,indices_a,weights_a,indices_b,weights_b)
 return best
for label,indices in [('selection',[4,5]),('whole',range(len(tris08)))]:
 results=[]
 for triangle_a in indices:
  for triangle_b in range(len(tris02)):
   result=closest_triangle_pair(verts08[tris08[triangle_a]],verts02[tris02[triangle_b]])
   results.append((result[0],triangle_a,triangle_b,result))
 best=min(results,key=lambda item:item[0])
 distance,triangle_a,triangle_b,result=best
 print(label,'distance',format(distance,'.15f'),'M08 triangle',triangle_a,'M02 triangle',triangle_b)
 print('point08',result[1].tolist(),'point02',result[2].tolist(),'unit direction',((result[2]-result[1])/distance).tolist(),'margin',distance-4.5)
 print('barycentric support',result[3:])
 print('per triangle minima',[(triangle_a,min(row[0] for row in results if row[1]==triangle_a)) for triangle_a in indices])
